rationale: All artifact uses correctly frame the DAA architecture as a project proposal or illustrative hypothesis, explicitly disclaiming it as an approved design or certified safety evidence. The artifacts also actively address the challenge by highlighting shared perception failures and requiring explicit qualifiers (e.g., 'This project proposes...') in the narration and visual inventory.
limitations: The architecture remains a theoretical framework and requires case-specific evidence to validate its safety claims in a real-world application.
